notes: No genuine Christmas/Halloween/Diwali/Valentine/Easter/Thanksgiving/New Year/Holi/Eid or other seasonal-holiday product category exists on the GB storefront as of 2026-09-03. Direct HTTP fetch of the SPA app pages (curl_cffi with Chrome impersonation, and plain curl) was blocked by an Akamai Bot Manager interstitial/challenge on every app URL (robots.txt and static sitemap XML/gz files were reachable directly, no challenge). Access moved to tier 2: headless Playwright/Chromium returned a hard Access Denied (Akamai edge block); switching to a real installed Chrome browser channel in non-headless mode rendered the site normally (status 200). No Claude-specific (anthropic-ai/ClaudeBot/Claude-Web/Claude-User/Claude-SearchBot) disallow in robots.txt, so no policy_opt_out applies. Checked independently: (1) the live rendered page's embedded storefront menu API state (/api/storefront/1/stores/84009906/menu, the full mega-menu used to build the site nav) - 39 top-level branches (New In, Home Office, Bedding, Home Decor, Furniture, Kitchen and Dining, Bathroom, Fragrances, Kids and Baby, Special Prices, Clothing and Footwear, Laundry Care, Pets Collection, Gym Collection, Music Collection, Books, Editorials, Culinary Stories, etc.) and their full subtrees (668 lines total, including the entire Home Decor branch: Mirrors, Lamps and Lighting, Rugs, Cushions, Vases, Decorative Accessories, Decorative Candles, Candle Holders, Baskets, Flowerpots, etc.) - no Christmas/Halloween/Diwali/Festive/Holiday/seasonal branch anywhere. (2) the site's own current GB category sitemap (robots.txt -> sitemap-index-home-categories-zh.xml -> sitemap-home-categories-zh-gb-0.xml.gz, freshly generated 2026-09-02, 321 category URLs) scanned for christmas/xmas/halloween/diwali/deepavali/valentine/easter/thanksgiving/new-year/holi/rakhi/navratri/dussehra/eid/ramadan/festive/festival keywords - the only hit was 'christmas-editorial-2-n4588'. (3) the full rendered /gb/sitemap.html link tree (1.2MB, same technique used for the AE storefront, SR21) - same single hit, no others, and no halloween/diwali/valentine/easter/thanksgiving/xmas(non-editorial)/holi/rakhi/navratri/dussehra/eid/ramadan/festive/festival matches at all. Investigated that one hit directly: 'christmas-editorial-2' is a repurposed legacy slug now serving 'CULINARY STORIES WITH IMOGEN KWOK AND THIERRY BOUTEMY' - a recipe/editorial content page (seo.irrelevant=true, isCanonicalReference=true), not a product-listing category - excluded per core rules (editorial/blog, never extract). The only other 'xmas' occurrences anywhere in the menu/sitemap data are individual recipe names (e.g. 'From the sea to the orchard', 'Chicken roasted on a bed of hay') filed under Culinary Stories editorial content, not product categories. A site-search discrimination check for 'christmas' and 'halloween' via the /gb/search endpoint redirected to the site's own error/no-match page (PAGE UNAVAILABLE) for both terms, consistent with no matching category or search index entry rather than a genuine result set (search alone was not relied on as proof; the nav+sitemap investigation above is the basis for this conclusion). GB is a temperate-climate UK market with none of the Indian-subcontinent festivals in its taxonomy either. It is plausible the Christmas assortment for this market had not yet launched as of this early-September check date; absence is recorded based on the site's current live taxonomy only.
